title: Fppf scalar-quotient characterization of a projective linear group scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $r\in\mathbf N$, and $G$ a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. For a $k$-scheme $T$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], let $Q(T)=\operatorname{GL}_r(\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T))/\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)^\times$, the quotient of the invertible matrices of [def-sc-general-linear-group] by scalar units. Say that $G$ represents the projective linear fppf quotient if there are natural injective group homomorphisms $q_T:Q(T)\to\operatorname{Hom}_k(T,G)$ and every $x:T\to G$ locally lies in their images: there is an fppf covering sieve $R$ on $T$ [def-pc-fppf-site] such that for every $h:W\to T$ in $R$ there is $g\in Q(W)$ with $q_W(g)=x\circ h$. Naturality uses entrywise pullback of matrices along the pullback map on global sections. Equivalently $G$ represents the fppf sheafification of this scalar-quotient presheaf.
